integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the bounded-morphism back condition and properness consequences, derives the m-squared lower bound, and then classifies the equality case. The 2025 primary full text was inspected throughout its finite properization construction and summary theorem; the 2026 simplicial-belief paper was inspected at its discussion of representational redundancy. Candidate-specific database and literature searches did not locate the lower bound, optimality statement, or Latin-square equality classification.
scientific_limitations: The exact quadratic lower bound is proved for complete two-agent S5 targets and proper S5 covers connected by a surjective bounded morphism. It is not asserted for arbitrary non-equivalence relations or for three or more agents. The Latin-square characterization is after naming the two equivalence-class families.
title: Quadratic proper-cover blow-up is sharp for two-agent \(\mathsf{S5}\)
